title: Reader Chapter 31
hook: A reader-facing chapter under phase-1 review.

examples.title: Fenna pulls the warm invoice from the printer
examples.scenario: Fenna touches a warm invoice sheet at Thursday 3:03 p.m. in the billing alcove at Northgate Dental, office manager, with toner dust on her thumb. She snapped at the hygienist over a coding error and called it efficiency. After the door closed, Fenna saw the older feeling under it: fear that another rejected claim would wreck payroll. Fenna she writes that fear on a sticky note before apologizing.
examples.whyItMatters: It shows the skill in context.

examples.title: Jae stops the pen above the form
examples.scenario: Jae stops a black ballpoint pen at Wednesday 2:08 p.m. in the patient relations desk at Hillcrest Clinic, patient advocate, with a complaint form with coffee on one corner. The man across from Jae says the nurse ignored his pain. Jae has the chart, the vitals, and a policy answer ready. His hands keep rubbing the same spot on his knee. Jae Jae must decide whether to defend the chart or ask what the morning felt like from his side.
examples.whyItMatters: It shows the skill in context.
